task: binary fish / non-fish; UVMulti colors mapped explicitly
initialization: legacy SUIM SegFormer-B0 encoder and decoder, binary classifier initialized from fish row and mean non-fish rows
sampling: 50% fish-directed crop, 25% random crop, 25% full image; train video GT only
selection: macro per-video fish IoU on ORIGINAL development images every128 steps; no reconstructed codec images or final test used
